name: Elena Rodriguez
bio:
Elena's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with her father. This early exposure fueled her pursuit of a degree in mechanical engineering, which she completed with honors. Eager to apply her knowledge, she joined a small racing team as a junior engineer, quickly demonstrating her aptitude for problem-solving and her unwavering commitment to performance.

At Prema Junior, Elena is known for her methodical approach and her ability to see the bigger picture. She excels at identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to optimize car performance. Her calm demeanor under pressure allows her to make critical decisions effectively, even in the heat of competition. Elena's pragmatic mindset and dedication to technical excellence make her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring that every aspect of the car is meticulously analyzed and refined.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on a clean and organized workspace.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
